name: qa-severity-calibration
description: QA agent reviews a code change that broadens an allowlist. The change improves functionality and is clearly intentional, but technically deviates from the original spec. A good QA agent should note the deviation as MINOR (informational) rather than IMPORTANT/CRITICAL, and should NOT flag it as a blocking issue. Tests severity calibration — the FM-2.3 SPEC_LITERALISM pattern.
